summary: Added localhost-only administrator firewall diagnostics using the operating system authentication prompt. Veyra itself remains unprivileged.
instructions: Open Settings → Administrator diagnostics, or open /admin using http://localhost:3000 on the Veyra PC. Click Inspect firewall and approve the operating system authentication dialog. This runs only nft list ruleset, never changes firewall rules, and never accepts a password in a web form or chat. Results stay in memory and are not automatically sent to the model. Tested fixed-command validation, duplicate prevention, authentication failure handling, localhost-only API access, and update injection. On this PC the live attempt failed with “No authentication agent found”; a desktop polkit authentication agent is required before inspection can succeed. The video share still returns HTTP 200 locally, but the iPhone connectivity cause remains unconfirmed. Do not reuse the password posted in chat; change it through trusted system settings.
